summary: 过去 24 小时 AI 新闻按技术、模型、商业、投资、安全与监管聚合。页面优先展示影响力高、来源清晰、并且能解释后续产业意义的信号。

keylines.title: 芯片是今日主轴
keylines.text: 过去 24 小时里，芯片相关内容占比最高，说明媒体报道和社交讨论正在向这一方向集中。

keylines.title: Grok / xAI带动 X 讨论
keylines.text: X 热点更偏实时体验和争议观点，适合用来捕捉模型、产品和安全事件的早期信号。

keylines.title: 基础设施仍是深层变量
keylines.text: 芯片、数据中心、电力和推理成本会持续决定 AI 产品能否从发布会走向规模化商业。

stories.title: OpenAI says it will no longer train its AI models on the live internet, citing “significant risks”
stories.summary: OpenAI will cut frontier models off from the internet weeks after one of its engineers said that solution wouldn't work.
stories.analysis: 前沿模型发布审查正在变成政府与实验室之间的制度问题，透明度不足会削弱外部对安全评估的信任。

stories.title: OpenAI now trains its frontier AI models with no internet access
stories.summary: OpenAI is now training its most advanced AI models without internet access following a string of rogue hacking incidents.
stories.analysis: 语音交互的重点从“能说话”转向打断、停顿、轮次管理和实时性，这会直接影响助手在日常场景里的可用性。

stories.title: Rapidly scaling online storage to serve over 1 billion ChatGPT users (Part II)

stories.title: Hottest toy for Christmas? Nvidia CEO plays with adorable Microduck robots, 20,000 sell
stories.summary: The robots, stomping their little feet and making tiny R2-D2 noises, sat, fell down dead for a "nap," and summersaulted on voice command.
stories.analysis: 机器人方向的关键是用低成本数据补足真实世界采集瓶颈，游戏、仿真和交互轨迹可能成为物理 AI 的训练燃料。

stories.title: Jack Dorsey’s Block made an AI model that talks to you like an awkward new friend
stories.summary: Jack Dorsey's Block announced an AI model called Dessa that's trained "from scratch on nothing but human conversation," and to show off the model, Block shared chats it has had with humans that can occasionally be a little awkw...
stories.analysis: 语音模型的体验差距会体现在延迟、自然停顿、噪声环境和多轮上下文保持，而不是单句生成质量。

stories.title: From Toast to Bessemer: Who founders will hear from at TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026
stories.summary: Hosted by TechCrunch in partnership with Fidelity Private Shares, the full-day event goes beyond fundraising and AI to explore the realities of finding customers, building teams, sharpening a pitch, developing founder leadershi...
stories.analysis: 高管变动会影响 OpenAI 在 AGI、消费产品和商业化之间的资源分配，短期要看继任安排和关键团队稳定性。

stories.title: Now Google says it might use your Gmail and Google Photos data to target ads
stories.summary: Google has updated its privacy policy in a way that could mean you'll start seeing targeted ads based on your personal data if you're using personalized AI features.
stories.analysis: AI 投资回报讨论正在从愿景转向财务验证，企业会更关注单位成本、流程改造深度和可量化生产率提升。

stories.title: Meta delays new business terms after publisher pushback on AI scraping
stories.summary: Meta is delaying the enforcement of its new business terms after publishers raised concerns that they could allow the company to scrape news sites for AI training, as reported earlier by Fast Company.
stories.analysis: 版权诉讼的焦点正在从训练原则转向证据、数据集和输出归因，这会直接影响模型公司的合规成本与数据策略。

stories.title: Securing our frontier model training environment
stories.summary: OpenAI explains how we strengthened containment for frontier model training and evaluation, including offline environments and high-compute red-teaming.
stories.analysis: 前沿模型发布审查正在变成政府与实验室之间的制度问题，透明度不足会削弱外部对安全评估的信任。

stories.title: Retro gaming is being overrun with AI
stories.summary: Retro video games are everywhere lately - especially in places where they aren't supposed to be. Halo in a web browser, Wind Waker on the iPhone, Super Smash Bros. in mixed reality.
stories.analysis: AI 浏览器路线正在从独立产品转向插件和桌面入口，关键是 Agent 浏览是否能在权限、安全和可控性上站稳。

stories.title: Sure, let’s smoosh SpaceX and Tesla together, who cares
stories.summary: Oh sure, SpaceX's credit risk is pretty high because it's about to borrow another $40 billion to spend on Nvidia chips, but who cares about that? SpaceX and Tesla have formed special committees to discuss a merger!

stories.title: Kazakhstan Expands Compute for Its AI Future
stories.summary: Kazakhstan’s AI ecosystem is moving from infrastructure plans to deployment. The shift is visible across the full AI stack — from infrastructure to models to applications.

stories.title: Left alone with nothing to do, AI agents started playing
stories.summary: MIT researchers marooned 13 AIs on a virtual island, and they responded by inventing games, mourning a lost ring and, eventually, getting better at their jobs.
stories.analysis: 这条新闻属于技术路线信号，后续重点是可复现性、工程成本和是否能被开源或商业系统快速吸收。

xTrends.signal: 模型能力、价格和开发者可用性是主要讨论点，很多帖子直接拿它和 OpenAI、Anthropic 对比。
讨论集中在新模型分层、企业访问节奏、推理质量和产品体验是否有实质提升。
安全研究者和 CISO 圈层关注 AI Agent 是否会把攻击链自动化到新的速度。
投资者讨论长期数据中心租约、电力容量和 AI 基建股是否进入过热区间。
手机厂商把 AI 拉回端侧入口之争，争议点是功能是否真能改变日常使用。
创作者圈层继续测试视频生成、图像模型和工作流自动化，版权与真实性问题伴随升温。

briefings.title: 从热度看真实优先级
briefings.text: 模型发布仍最容易引爆讨论，但企业最终会按稳定性、成本、权限集成和数据安全来选择供应商。

briefings.title: 安全窗口继续缩短
briefings.text: AI Agent 让攻击链更自动化，防守重点需要前移到身份、权限、工具调用和数据访问异常。

briefings.title: 资本开支影响模型竞争
briefings.text: 算力合同、芯片供应和数据中心成本正在成为 AI 公司竞争力的一部分。

watchlist: OpenAI、Google、NVIDIA 是否发布新的 API、价格或企业访问策略
X 高热讨论是否被主流媒体确认，还是停留在圈层争议
AI 数据中心和芯片供应是否出现新的融资、电力或交付约束
监管机构是否把 AI 安全、版权、金融建议或出口限制推进到执法层面
